items.headline: Far East Orchard buys London site for US$79.3m student housing project
items.summary: Singapore-listed Far East Orchard has acquired a freehold development site in London for US$79.3 million. The site will be developed into purpose-built student accommodation, with a separate key-worker accommodation component.
items.why_it_matters: The purchase extends Far East Orchard's push into UK living-sector real estate, adding another income-generating asset class alongside its existing hospitality portfolio.

items.headline: Addvalue shareholders approve spinoff of unit for separate Nasdaq listing
items.summary: Shareholders of Addvalue have approved a plan to spin off its Addvalue Solutions unit into a new holding company that will pursue an initial public offering on Nasdaq. The restructuring will dilute existing Addvalue shareholders as new shares are issued in the IPO.
items.why_it_matters: The spinoff gives Addvalue Solutions a direct route to Nasdaq capital markets, a structure other Singapore-listed tech units may look to replicate to unlock value separate from their parent.
